schema.title: Response List Checkins Api Checkin Get

post.description:
Record the day's checkin, replacing any existing entry for that date.

Returns ``201`` on first record of the day, ``200`` when an existing entry
is updated. In live mode the checkin is pushed to CoachAgent in the
background; in standalone nothing is queued.

get.description: Return today's checkin, or ``404`` if it has not been recorded yet.
List the user's feedback, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Feedback Api Feedback Session Get

post.description:
Record feedback for an activity, replacing any prior entry for it.

Returns ``201`` on first record, ``200`` when an existing entry is updated.
``source`` is always set to ``app_manual`` server-side. In live mode the
feedback is pushed to CoachAgent in the background; in standalone nothing is
queued.
